result.summary: Exact frozen policy completed eight independent fresh2500 generic-greedy Slumbot sessions. Read-only recovery from a post-cohort hardcoded5000 guard verified all20000 hands: -41.8162 bb/100, raw95%CI[-74.4660,-9.1664], session-t7 CI[-73.4110,-10.2214],0/8 positive sessions.
result.conclusion: The positive fresh5k point did not replicate; both raw-hand and session-level20k intervals are entirely negative. Procedural-family generalization plus raw-parent state preservation did not transfer to Slumbot. The policy is rejected and receives no100k qualification.
result.next_step: End procedural-opponent proxy promotion.
